BillHeading.BriefDescription: Concerning defenses in personal injury and wrongful death actions where the person injured or killed was committing a felony.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to defenses in personal injury and wrongful death actions where the person injured or killed was committing a felony; and amending RCW 4.24.420.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. RCW 4.24.420 and 1987 c 212 s 901 are each amended to read as follows:Action by person committing a felony—Defense—Actions under 42 U.S.C. Sec. 1983.
BillSection.P: It (1) Except in an action arising out of law enforcement activities resulting in personal injury or death, it is a complete defense to any action for damages for personal injury or wrongful death that the person injured or killed was engaged in the commission of a felony at the time of the occurrence causing the injury or death and the felony was a proximate cause of the injury or death. However, nothing

P.TextRun: (2) In an action arising out of law enforcement activities resulting in personal injury or death, it is a complete defense to the action that the finder of fact has determined beyond a reasonable doubt that the person injured or killed was engaged in the commission of a felony at the time of the occurrence causing the injury or death, the commission of which was a proximate cause of the injury or death.

BillSection.P: (3) Nothing in this section shall affect a right of action under 42 U.S.C. Sec. 1983.
